headline: Signed agreement raising Scheer Science Scholarship award from $500 to $1,000, to go to DOJ for final approval.
summary: Cambridge Trust reviewed the trust fund investments, and all funds have now moved to the firm. Trustees also approved minutes from the April and July meetings and signed two expenditure reports.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the April 15, 2026 meeting, 3-0.
Approved the minutes of the July 15, 2026 meeting, 3-0.
Signed the agreement to raise the Scheer Science Scholarship award from $500 to $1,000.
Signed two expenditure reports, for April to June 2026 and July to September 2026.

decision_evidence.quote: Trustee Fredette moved to approve the minutes of the April 15, 2026 meeting, seconded by Trustee Wilshire. 3-0: Motion carried
Trustee Fredette moved to approve the minutes of the July 15, 2026 meeting, seconded by Trustee Kane. 3-0: Motion carried
Reviewed NJSA for the Scheer Science Scholarship changing the award from $500 to $1,000. The Trustees signed the agreement and will forward it to the DOJ for final approval.
The two Expenditure reports from April 2026 to June 2026, and July 2026 to September 2026 was signed by the Trustees.

decision_titles: Scheer Science Scholarship award increase, $500 to $1,000
plain_text:
City of Nashua, NH 
Trustees of Trust Fund and Capital Reserve Meeting 
Room 208 Auditorium – Nashua City Hall 
229 Main Street, Nashua NH 
Wednesday, October 14, 2026 @ 4pm 
MINUTES 
 
Members Present -, Trustee Kristin Kane, Trustee David Fredette, President Board of Aldermen 
Lori Wilshire 
Members Absent - Mayor James Donchess, Treasurer/Tax Collector Diane Mulholland 
Also Present –  CFO Dawn Enwright , Lisa Tourangeau, Cambridge Trust and Eric Jussaume, 
Cambridge Trust 
Meeting was called to order by CFO Dawn Enwright at 4:05PM 
Trustee Fredette moved to approve the minutes of the April 15, 2026 meeting, seconded by 
Trustee Wilshire. 
3-0: Motion carried 
Trustee Fredette moved to approve the minutes of the July 15, 2026 meeting, seconded by 
Trustee Kane. 
3-0: Motion carried 
 
1. Cambridge Trust presented information regarding the transition of Trust Funds to 
Cambridge Trust.  Lisa Tourangeau presented the September MS9 report just for those 
funds. Eric Jussaume presented an overview of the current investments and reviewed 
them with the Trustee of Trust Funds. At this time all funds have been moved to 
Cambridge Trust. 
 
2. Reviewed NJSA for the Scheer Science Scholarship changing the award from $500 to 
$1,000.  The Trustees signed the agreement and will forward it to the DOJ for final 
approval.
3. Old Committee Business 
a. None 
 
The two Expenditure reports from April 2026 to June 2026, and July 2026 to September 
2026 was signed by the Trustees. 
 
4. Next meeting: January 13, 2027 at 4PM- 
Trustee Wilshire moved to adjourn, seconded by Trustee Kane at 4:50PM 
3-0: Motion carried 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
 
Diane Mulholland, Treasurer/ Tax Collector
